What We Do

Our Roofing and Guttering Services

From a few slipped tiles to a complete new roof, plus the flat roofs, chimneys and gutters around it.

Roof Repairs

Slipped and broken tiles, leaks and storm damage found and put right before the damage spreads.

Get a quote

New Roofs

Stripped back and rebuilt with new membrane, battens and tiles or slates, with advice on the right roof for the house.

Get a quote

Flat Roofing

Practical, low-maintenance flat roofs for extensions, garages, conversions and outbuildings.

Get a quote

Guttering, Fascias and Soffits

UPVC gutters, fascias and soffits that keep rainwater off the walls and need very little upkeep.

Get a quote

Chimney Repairs

Chimney stacks repaired and made watertight, with new lead flashing where the stack meets the roof.

Get a quote

Tiling and Slating

Breathable membrane and treated battens laid properly under new tiles or slates, roof windows included.

See The Difference

Before and After

Two recent jobs: a rear roof re-tiled, and a new roof valley going in.

Before → After
Re-tiling

Rear Roof Re-Tile

The roof over this rear extension was stripped back and re-battened, with the new tiles loaded out ready. It was finished in red tiles to suit the house, with both roof windows fitted back in.

Before During
Lead and Valleys

New Roof Valley

The old valley came out, with the tiles lifted back on both sides and the worn mortar and lining showing. The new grey valley then went in down the same line, ready for the tiles to go back.

About Us

The Team Behind Proguard Roofing and Guttering

George Inman runs Proguard, the third generation of roofing and building contractors in his family. It's a family run business with 25 years behind it.

Proguard covers roofing, flat roofs and guttering across Sussex, from new roofs and re-tiles to chimney repairs and new fascias. Every job starts with a free, no-obligation quote and plain advice on what the roof actually needs, and finishes with the property left clean and tidy.
